TO

THE PRINCIPAL MAAM AND ALL THE TEACHERS OF SHRI SHIKSHAYATAN SCHOOL.

Here’s a sincere message of gratitude to all the teachers of SHRI SHIKSHAYATAN SCHOOL, those who guide our children through some of the most chaotic times of our lives. We want to remind you how much of an impact you can have, not just on each student you teach, but as a profession and a community long after classes are over.

It has been almost two years that we are facing this neo-normal, pandemic situation.

I know you miss your students, the classroom community, and the culture you cultivated. I know how much your students mean to you — how they become “your kids” year after year — and how much you love seeing them light up when they learn something new.

You have a place in our kids’ lives. Whether they’re groaning about doing the work you’ve assigned, anxiously awaiting a phone call from you, or gleefully trying to get your attention during your virtual class meeting- it’s because you matter.

I’m doing my best to support my child’s at-home learning.  I’m supervising, but you, the teachers, are doing the heavy lifting. I know how hard teaching is.

Dear teachers, parents can’t replace you. You are essential. Take care of yourselves . Be well. Try your best. And thank you for being there.The school may have found a teacher in you, but our child found a hero in you.

Thanks and regards.

Debadatta Ghosh Das

ADVOCATE.
